The handoff delay counts only while the character remains continuously ready: logged in, present, alive, conscious, out of area transitions, and out of cutscenes. Runtime ADS ownership is authoritative even after manual Start Inside. FrenRider pauses local duty systems while handoff is pending or ADS owns the run; configured exit takeover remains available after duty completion.
